high_level_description: The image depicts a close-up of a piece of parchment with a handwritten message. The parchment is aged, with a slightly yellowed appearance and some visible creases, giving it an old and worn look. The text on the parchment is written in a formal, somewhat urgent tone, addressing someone named "Naowww." The message reads: "Naowww, I write with the utmost urgency. The people of Mount Zavain need your help once more. The black mists born from the Zakarum's vile crusades have spread across Zavain and nightmares pour from within."
